    @pytest.mark.parametrize("arch", ["gfx1250", "gfx1251"])
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", ["fp16", "bf16"])
    def test_gfx125x_wmma_v2_lowers_modifiers_and_assembles(
        compiler_toolchain, arch, dtype,
    ):
        source = _gfx125x_source("bf16" if dtype == "bf16" else "fp16")
        lowered = _lower(compiler_toolchain, arch, source, generic=True)
        assert f"rocdl.wmma.f32.16x16x32.{dtype.replace('fp', 'f')}" in lowered
        # LLVM 23's gfx125x f16/bf16 WMMA-v2 ops encode only the C modifier and
        # reuse controls.  signA/signB are not properties of this typed op.
        assert "signA" not in lowered

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("arch", ["gfx1250", "gfx1251"])

    def test_gfx125x_wmma_v2_lowers_modifiers_and_assembles(
        compiler_toolchain, arch, dtype,
    ):
        source = _gfx125x_source("bf16" if dtype == "bf16" else "fp16")
        lowered = _lower(compiler_toolchain, arch, source, generic=True)
        assert f"rocdl.wmma.f32.16x16x32.{dtype.replace('fp', 'f')}" in lowered

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("arch", ["gfx1250", "gfx1251"])
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", ["fp16", "bf16"])
    def test_gfx125x_wmma_v2_lowers_modifiers_and_assembles(
        compiler_toolchain, arch, dtype,
    ):
        source = _gfx125x_source("bf16" if dtype == "bf16" else "fp16")
        lowered = _lower(compiler_toolchain, arch, source, generic=True)
        assert f"rocdl.wmma.f32.16x16x32.{dtype.replace('fp', 'f')}" in lowered

        # reuse controls.  signA/signB are not properties of this typed op.

    def _build_hsaco(mt=1, nt=1) -> bytes:
        TESSERA_OPT = require_tessera_opt(*_ROCM_PASSES)
        mlir_opt = _find_mlir_opt()

            "gpu-module-to-binary)"
        )

                             input=gen.stdout, capture_output=True, text=True)

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("mt,nt", _MACRO_TILES)

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("mt,nt", _MACRO_TILES)
    def test_register_blocked_matches_oracle(mt, nt):
        """Stage L2 — each wave computes an mt x nt grid of 16x16 output tiles
        (register blocking, fragment reuse). Register blocking changes only data
        reuse, not the per-output accumulation order, so the result stays
